Usage: tool repo remove <names> ... [flags]

Forget repositories; their files stay.

Arguments:
  <names> ...        Names of the repositories to forget.

Flags:
  -f, --force        Forget them even with unpushed work.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help         Show context-sensitive help.
      --json         Print one JSON object instead of text.
      --home=HOME    Root of the registry (default: ~/.local/state/tool; env: $CLIKIT_TEST_HOME).

Output:
  --json prints one object; text otherwise.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    failed
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
  5    done, but some repositories need attention
